items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: I had met him in Natchez later, years after I left here.

ctx.x: It wasn't John Marrero. I used to call him Ruth Gordon, and yeah, him. And there was another fella, oh he was fast, and he was a younger boy, he was wild. I mean, I think he was a sincere, Poise Sevier. Poise Sevier, yeah, I've heard George Williams about him. Poise Sevier, yeah, oh he was just fast, he was fast as lightning. But he had a different style in those fellas, and I had met him in Natchez later, years after I left here. But those were about the two, well I never did pay much attention to banjo players…
Did you ever take up the guitar? No, I never take up the guitar.
